Class Odom

java.lang.Object
org.firstinspires.ftc.teamcode.subsystems.Odom
All Implemented Interfaces:
dev.nextftc.core.subsystems.Subsystem
public class Odom extends Object implements dev.nextftc.core.subsystems.Subsystem
Odometry subsystem wrapping the goBILDA Pinpoint Odometry Computer ("odom"). Stores single-source-of-truth calibration constants shared with Pedro Pathing's Constants.java.
